hazards.control: Tubing handled with elevators and slips by trained crews; the derrick inspected before the job.

name: Mast, crown, and traveling block
function: The telescoping mast with the crown block at the top and the traveling block on the drilling line that lifts the tubing.

tabs.overview: The block travels one joint per cycle while tubing is run; elevators under the block latch each joint.
tabs.engineering: Rated hook load; line count and drilling line size.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
